rows.text: In the House of Councillors Budget Committee on 22 May 2001, 小泉純一郎 (printed ○内閣総理大臣（小泉純一郎君）) says that in this LDP presidential election (今回の自民党総裁選) he became president against most expectations, and that party members and Diet members chose him (私を選任してくれた).

bounded_scope: Party-office observations of the LDP president (総裁) for CLAUDE-C01-18 only, 1990-2009 (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-13). Party elections and selections (member and Diet-member votes, joint plenary meetings of party Diet members), notices, candidacies, declarations and reports of results, statements of assumption, in-office attestations, announced and prospective resignations, predecessor references and retrospective records stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row. A null holder_name means the source names no holder of this office (a notice, a filing, a schedule, an unnamed caption or a meeting). The prime-ministership (jp_pm) is excluded: no row feeds it, and no jp_pm claim feeds this office.
